overview_description.description: picplz is a photo sharing app that makes it easy for you to share your mobile pictures on the Web with just a few clicks. It also makes it simple to add a caption, tag your location and check-in. Pictures taken with picplz are synced to your profile on picplz.com and tagged with your location. picplz integrates with Facebook, Twitter, Flickr, Tumblr, Posterous & Foursquare. picplz makes it easy see the moments people you follow choose to share as well as to browse photos that were taken in a specific city or place. The app also lets you add great looking photo filters for free. Some of the current effects include "Instant Film," "Russian Toy Camera," "the 70s" and "High Contrast Monochrome."
